desc:
Run, climb, jump, and escape in the fast-paced world of Ape Tag. Outsmart Lava Monkeys, find hidden routes, and master movement to become the fastest ape alive.

Can you survive… or will you get tagged?

🐒 Escape as a Monkey
🔥 Chase as a Lava Monkey
💰 Earn Crystals & Shards by playing and surviving
🕶️ Unlock Cosmetics, Skins, Emotes & Effects
🏆 Survive until time runs out to win

💎 Collect FREE Crystals every Saturday!

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates
🎁 Join the Group for bonuses
🔔 Join our server for codes & rewards

Ape Tag is just getting started.
